items.title: Eddie Alley interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: my favorite band of all time in the beginning was Jimmie Lunceford. Jimmie Lunceford knocked me out. That’s what I tried to pattern my style after.

ctx.x: Okay, the big bands would come through I would imagine. Who did you get to hear? © Fillius Jazz Archive -13-
Well my favorite band, my first favorite band of all time in the beginning was Jimmie Lunceford. Jimmie Lunceford knocked me out. That’s what I tried to pattern my style after. “Sweet Swing.”
